spans.s:
शृणि शृणि, इस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. शॄ), the
hook for goading an elephant, (also written सृणि.)

. fr. rt. सृ above), an enemy; the moon; (इस्), f.
a hook used to drive an elephant (also written शृणि,
q. v.); a weapon (Ved.).
सृणी, f. = सृणि, a hook for driving an elephant.
शृण्वत् शृण्वत्. See under rt. 1. श्रु.

शृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, hearing, listening to, hearken-
ing.
शृणान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hurting, injuring.

सृण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful in weapons or arms,
(according to Sāy. = आयुध-कुशल, and connected
with सृणि above, Ṛg-veda
